Signs your water heater needs help

  • No hot water, or it runs out fast
  • Water pooling around the base of the tank
  • Rusty or discolored hot water
  • Popping or rumbling sounds from the tank

A leaking tank can get worse quickly. Turn off the water supply to the heater and give us a call.
